Container.Name: Filehub
Container.Overview: Filehub is a lightweight, self-hosted file manager for sharing folders among users on your own server.
Container.Description:
Filehub is a lightweight, self-hosted file manager for sharing folders among users on your own server.
Features include per-user home folders, shared folders with read/write access and an optional Allow delete flag, public link shares, image/PDF/video previews, ffmpeg thumbnails, and optional TOTP 2FA.
First boot: leave ADMIN_PASSWORD unset. After the container starts, open /mnt/user/appdata/nas-filehub/admin-credentials.txt for the generated admin password, sign in, then change it under Settings → Change password. That credentials file is written once and is never overwritten.
Prefer a reverse proxy with HTTPS, and set SECURE_COOKIES=true once you are behind HTTPS. Do not expose the WebUI port directly to the public internet.
Optional Intel VAAPI thumbnails: keep the /dev/dri device mapping and set THUMB_VAAPI=true. If your server has no /dev/dri, remove the device mapping and leave THUMB_VAAPI=false.
The optional Unraid shares path is mounted at /data/files/shares so you can create shared folders with paths such as shares/Movies. You can remove that mapping if you do not need it.
Container.Requires: After the first start, read the generated admin password in /mnt/user/appdata/nas-filehub/admin-credentials.txt, then change it under Settings → Change password. Prefer a reverse proxy; do not expose the WebUI port to the public internet. For Intel VAAPI thumbnails, keep /dev/dri mapped and set THUMB_VAAPI=true. If /dev/dri is not present, remove the device mapping.
Container.Changes: Community Apps template and GHCR image for Filehub. Leave ADMIN_PASSWORD unset on first boot and read the generated password from appdata/nas-filehub/admin-credentials.txt.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP WebUI port (container 8080). Prefer a reverse proxy; do not expose this port directly to the public internet.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, thumbnails, generated admin-credentials.txt, and default files under /data/files.

Config.Name: Unraid shares
Config.Description: Optional mapping so Shared folders can use paths like shares/Movies. You can remove this mapping if you do not need host shares.

Config.Name: Intel GPU (/dev/dri)
Config.Description: Optional Intel iGPU for VAAPI thumbnail acceleration. If /dev/dri is not present on the host, remove this mapping and leave THUMB_VAAPI=false.

Config.Name: ADMIN_USER
Config.Description: Seed admin username on first boot only.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty on first boot so the entrypoint generates a password into /data/admin-credentials.txt. Only seeds the first boot; later changes must be made in Settings.

Config.Name: SECURE_COOKIES
Config.Description: Set true when the WebUI is served over HTTPS (reverse proxy). Leave false so http://IP:port login works on a first Unraid install.

Config.Name: THUMB_ENABLE
Config.Description: Generate image and video thumbnails with ffmpeg.

Config.Name: THUMB_VAAPI
Config.Description: Set true only when /dev/dri is mapped and you want Intel VAAPI thumbnail acceleration.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Optional public site URL used in password-reset emails (for example https://filehub.example.com).

Config.Name: MAX_UPLOAD_MB
Config.Description: Maximum upload size in MiB (application default is 2048).
